description:
Search businesses

Search the KVK Handelsregister (company database) by company name or
KVK number. Only main establishments (hoofdvestigingen) are returned.
The response is flat: `pagina`, `resultatenPerPagina`, `totaal` and
`resultaten[]`, with per result the fields `kvkNummer`, `rsin`,
`vestigingsnummer`, `naam`, `rechtsvorm`, `adres` (a flat object),
`actief` (boolean) and `vervallenNaam`. A local cache (48 hours) serves repeated
queries.

Results per page can be: 5, 10, 25, 50, or 75 (default 25).

At least one of `naam` or `kvkNummer` is required.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kvk.search
